scope: 11 entries observed in the official catalogue; availability and links can change
attribution: Copernicus Data Stores Applications catalogue, ECMWF; C3S/CAMS and individual app/data contributors
reuse: Factual names, URLs, programme and dataset identifiers with original project teaching annotations; no publisher descriptions, images or code copied.

entries.name: Aerosol Alerts
entries.exercise: Compare issue time with valid time before interpreting a forecast layer.
entries.limitation: A forecast alert is not a measurement at a person's breathing height.

entries.name: Climate Pulse
entries.exercise: Compare absolute temperature, traditional anomaly, and relative Niño anomaly with fixed selections.
entries.limitation: A regional monthly mean is not a local extreme or a long-term warming level.

entries.name: Climate Atlas
entries.exercise: Compare a historical indicator with a future scenario using the same region and statistic.
entries.limitation: Conditional projections are not predictions of a particular event.

entries.name: ERA Explorer
entries.exercise: Select a location and inspect its historical seasonal cycle; record the grid and aggregation.
entries.limitation: A reanalysis grid value does not reproduce every local station measurement.

entries.name: Global temperature trend monitor
entries.exercise: Compare the app's trend method and reference period with an annual Pulse anomaly.
entries.limitation: One warm year and a sustained long-term warming threshold are different statements.

entries.name: NECD Explorer
entries.exercise: Compare the country's JFM temperature and JJA precipitation selections and threshold definitions.
entries.limitation: Its country statistic and seasonal definitions need not match a local or Atlas average.

entries.name: Methane Hotspot Explorer
entries.exercise: Inspect a displayed plume's acquisition time, quality information, and source attribution.
entries.limitation: A column enhancement does not alone identify an emitter or quantify a surface exposure.

entries.name: Thermal Trace
entries.exercise: Compare a thermal-stress indicator with the weather variables used to derive it.
entries.limitation: Air temperature alone is not a complete heat-stress assessment.

entries.name: European Climate Data Explorer
entries.exercise: Choose a European indicator and compare its scenario, units, and region with the Atlas.
entries.limitation: A similarly named indicator can have a different definition or aggregation.

entries.name: Weather Replay
entries.exercise: Inspect the same location and hour across temperature, wind, and precipitation layers.
entries.limitation: Hourly event evolution cannot be reconstructed from monthly global averages.

entries.name: Fire Emissions Watch
entries.exercise: Compare a fire-emissions signal with a smoke or atmospheric-composition view at matching times.
entries.limitation: Emissions, atmospheric concentrations, and human exposure are different quantities.
